jobs.occupation: Semiconductor process specialists - thin film deposition, plasma etching and characterisation - DTU Nanolab
jobs.description:
DTU Nanolab is looking for experienced engineers and physicists within thin film deposition, thin film plasma etching and thin film characterization in its ISO 4 & 5 cleanroom for micro- and nanofabrication.

We are seeking process specialists for the process specialist team. The team is responsible for thin-film deposition equipment (PVD, CVD, thermal processing), plasma etching systems, and a large suite of characterization tools (AFM, SEM, XRD, XPS, EDX, optical and stylus profilers, ellipsometers, reflectometers, PL mappers, and more). Responsibilities span the full equipment lifecycle, from procurement and implementation to documentation, maintenance, troubleshooting and the development of in-depth tool and process expertise needed to support users throughout a system's lifetime. 

The job
We are seeking people with experience and interest in plasma etching (ICP, IBE), plasma enhanced deposition (PECVD), AFM, sputter deposition, RTP annealing, PE-ALD, XRD and photo spectrometry. The job includes

• Process development of new processes and maintenance of current processes
• Documentation, including user manuals and process documentation
• In charge of QC and calibration procedures 
• Helping, training and education of users
• Assisting in fault finding in cooperation with technicians
• Assisting in procurement of new equipment: Specifications, demo runs and run-in
• Networking with other cleanroom labs in Europe
You will work closely with other process specialists and technicians in the Process Group, as well as with other DTU Nanolab groups, researchers, students and engineers from DTU and commercial companies. A large part of your working day will be spent in ISO 4 and 5 cleanrooms, where you will wear a full cleanroom suit.

Our expectations of you
You must have a M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree within either engineering or physics within a relevant field (micro/nanofabrication, experimental physics or similar) and have knowledge and experimental skills within the area of either plasma etching or thin film deposition and within different relevant characterization tools. 

Furthermore, we expect you to possess skills and qualifications in one or more of these areas:

• Plasma enhanced deposition (PECVD) and other CVD techniques (ALD and LPCVD)
• Plasma etching (ICP etching)
• PVD techniques (sputter deposition, e-beam evaporation and thermal evaporation)
• Thermal processing (oxidation, annealing and rapid thermal annealing)
• Thin film characterization techniques (AFM, XRD, photo spectrometry and other relevant)
• Hands-on experience working in a cleanroom environment
• Have a broad understanding of micro and nano processing
• Have an eye for detail and work meticulously
• Work well in teams with people from different backgrounds
• Service-minded
• Self-driven and able to plan your own working day
• Communicate well in written and spoken English. Knowledge of Danish is an advantage.
At DTU Nanolab, safety is a top priority, and we are looking for candidates who can thrive in a highly safety-conscious environment and meet the following physical and mental requirements: Is able to work in an environment where it can be necessary to wear specialized safety and protective equipment. Is able to respond quickly and effectively in emergency situations, including evacuation in case of alarms. Is able to perform tasks that require work while standing up and mobility for longer periods.

What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international work environment. The work is highly hands-on and with a large degree of variation. We place emphasis on a high level of professionalism among our staff, so skills development is an integral part of our organization. We offer a great flexibility in the position. Please note that this is not a research position, but a technical position, with a main focus to facilitate academic and industrial users within the field of thin film processing and characterization.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). You are employed as an Academic Officer. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 30 November 2026. Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Head of Operations, Leif Steen Johansen on +45 25 34 89 92 or lesjo@dtu.dk.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Nanolab is the National Center for Nanofabrication and Characterization in Denmark and an open-access research infrastructure at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU). As one of Europe’s largest fair-access micro- and nanofabrication centers, it offers a large cleanroom and advanced electron microscopy facilities. DTU Nanolab supports cutting-edge research and small-scale production within MEMS/NEMS, photonics, and quantum technologies, covering nano- and microfabrication as well as advanced analysis of hard and soft matter. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Marketing Manager, Nordics
jobs.description:
Department: Marketing

Location: EMEA-Denmark

**Description

**As Marketing Manager, Nordics, you will be responsible for developing and executing the marketing strategy and annual marketing plan for one of our business channels across the Nordic region, in line with company objectives, regional priorities, and global strategy.

You will play a key role in accelerating business growth by identifying market opportunities, driving customer engagement, strengthening customer adoption, and delivering impactful marketing initiatives that support our commercial objectives.

Working closely with commercial, clinical, and regional marketing teams, you will translate customer insights into effective marketing programs that drive customer success and long-term business performance.

You will report to the Senior Marketing Manager, Nordics and be based in Copenhagen, with regular travel across the Nordic region.

**Role expectations

****Strategic Growth & Business Development

**

• Lead the strategic growth of your assigned business channel across the Nordics by identifying and executing high-impact growth opportunities in alignment with EMEA strategy and in close collaboration with the commercial organization and Senior Marketing Manager.

• Proactively represents the Nordic region and our customers by providing market insights, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and business analytics to support new product development and global strategy.

• Identify local growth opportunities and champion initiatives that support business expansion beyond regional marketing plans.

• Focus on end-to-end excellence across products, services, and customer experiences while maintaining a broad market perspective and identifying future opportunities.

• Generate actionable customer, market, and competitive insights to shape commercial priorities and marketing investments.

**Marketing Planning & Execution

**

• Develop and execute the annual marketing plan for the assigned business channel, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives, company strategy, regional priorities, and global direction.

• Lead and execute channel marketing initiatives, including congresses, summits, customer events, speaker programs, educational activities, marketing playbooks, digital campaigns, and customer engagement programs.

• Own the end-to-end planning and delivery of key initiatives by defining timelines, responsibilities, materials, agency deliverables, stakeholder briefings, field team alignment, attendance where relevant, and post-activity follow-up.

• Champion regional and central marketing programs locally in close collaboration with sales, clinical, and regional teams, ensuring activities are translated into clear and practical execution for the Nordic markets.

• Use analytics and insights, including campaign ROI, customer reimbursement trends, market dynamics, competitive activity, and customer feedback, to continuously optimize marketing performance and improve future activities.

• Support successful product launches, commercialization strategies, and customer adoption initiatives.

**KOL & Customer Engagement

**

• Build and maintain strong relationships with KOLs, speakers, key customers, institutions, and professional associations across the Nordics.

• Partner with external stakeholders to deliver educational, scientific, and professional initiatives that strengthen customer engagement and thought leadership.

• Identify, brief, and support speakers and KOLs for congresses, educational programs, and customer-facing activities.

**Cross-Functional Leadership

**

• Partner closely with Commercial, Clinical, Finance, Education, Regional Marketing, and local country teams to ensure aligned execution and measurable business impact.

• Provide channel expertise, customer insights, campaign materials, messaging, and practical guidance to support successful local execution.

• Build stakeholder alignment across functions and markets to drive implementation of strategic initiatives.

**Digital Marketing & Innovation

**

• Utilize digital communication platforms, marketing technologies, AI-enabled tools, automation solutions, and analytics platforms to deliver and optimize marketing activities.

• Deliver integrated omnichannel campaigns that enhance customer engagement throughout the customer journey building the future of Digital dentistry.

• Explore innovative approaches to customer engagement and continuously evaluate emerging marketing trends and leverage EMEA and global best practices

**Training & Capability Building (consider erasing – repetition)

**

• Train and educate country stakeholders on relevant aspects of the business channel, customer journey, brand strategy, products, and marketing initiatives.

• Develop training materials and supporting collateral to enable effective execution across local teams and share best practices, customer insights, and market learnings to support continuous improvement across the Nordic organization.

**Experience

****What we're looking for

**

• 4+ years of relevant experience in B2B or healthcare marketing, preferably within the medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or Fast-Moving Consumer Healthcare (FMCH) industries.

• Demonstrated experience developing and implementing successful marketing strategies and campaigns.

• Experience working cross-functionally with commercial, clinical, and field-based teams.

• Experience managing agencies, events, and external partners.

• Proven ability to use data and insights to drive decision-making and business results.

• Hands-on experience with congress participation, event execution, agency coordination, customer-facing activities, digital campaigns, marketing materials, and follow-up processes.

**Skills

**

• Strong strategic mindset and commercial acumen.

• Ability to identify growth opportunities and translate insights into actionable initiatives.

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

• Excellent project management and organizational capabilities.

• Ability to work independently and navigate a matrix organization.

• Comfortable balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution.

• Proactive problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.

• Results-oriented and customer-focused approach.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, or a related discipline is required; a Master’s degree is considered an advantage.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and AI-enabled productivity tools.

• Fluent in English.

• Fluent in Danish or Swedish.

**Applicant Privacy Policy

**Review our Applicant Privacy Policyfor additional information.

**Equal Opportunity Statement

**Align Technology is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all our practices, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected category. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country for which they are applying, and employment eligibility will be verified as a condition of hire.

jobs.occupation: Manager for the Drug Product Development and Analysis Team
jobs.description:
Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where you can explore scientific challenges and have a significant impact? Are you passionate about developing life-saving vaccines, and enjoy close collaboration and leading a small development team?

We are expanding and looking for a new Manager to support our development projects!

**Join our team and let us make a difference together

**Our Process Development department in Hørsholm develops and optimizes vaccine production processes and supports our production sites. The Department handles diverse and evolving tasks and includes 32 members across 4 specialized teams.

We are looking for a manager to head our Drug Product Development and Analysis Team, consisting of three Scientists and three Technicians reporting to the Head of Process Development. The team focuses on drug product process and formulation development, stability studies, and analyzing development samples for ongoing programs.

Apart from managing the team an important part of the role will be hands-on to review analytical results, maintain the analytical methods and drive the execution of the analytical tasks in the team.

“We look forward to welcoming you to a dedicated and engaged department, where we value good team spirit and an easy-going, humorous environment,” says Janus Falhof, Head of Process Development.

**Your Impact

**You must have a strong interest in consistently delivering high-quality analytical data and to support the department’s development studies. Given the function of the team, there will be close interaction with all the teams in the department.

Your tasks will include:

• Driving the daily operation of the team, setting the scientific direction, and ensuring the development of the team members

• Ensuring established analysis assays run smoothly and deliver high-quality data on time, while supporting the team in developing new assays to advance the department

• Communicating daily with the team and collaborating closely with Production, Quality Control, and R&D

**Are You Our Next Pioneer?

**To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:

• M.S. in Biotechnology, Human Biology, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, preferably with a PhD in protein chemistry or a related topic

• 3-5 years of relevant experience from the biotech industry or academia Previous experience with pharmaceutical analyses, e.g. chromatographic methods, particle methods and protein methods

• Previous experience with formulation development, statistical data analysis, and an understanding of protein chemistry

• Fluency in spoken and written English is required

**Who Are You?

**You are self-driven, responsible, and approach scientific challenges with curiosity and innovation. Success relies on strong teamwork, people skills, and the ability to engage in cross-functional dialogue. A proactive, calm, and positive attitude, combined with adaptability to new priorities, is beneficial. Good teamwork abilities are essential in a diverse, international department.

**Why join us?

**

• Be part of a team that directly contributes to global health by manufacturing and developing life-saving vaccines

• Your work here has a visible and significant impact, ensuring the safety and well-being of millions

• Join the fascinating field of vaccine production, where every day brings new challenges and opportunities to protect public health

• Enjoy a vibrant staff club that offers a variety of diverse, fun, and exciting events

**Are you ready to join us in our mission?

**If this sounds like the next step in your career, we would love to hear from you.

We look forward to receiving your application together with your CV. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Product Owner, Compliance Technology
jobs.description:
**Product Owner, Compliance Technology

**Hybrid - Copenhagen or Manchester based

• Tech department

• Reports to VP of Payments & Revenue Technology

**About The Role

**OrderYOYO helps thousands of restaurant partners get up and running online quickly and safely, while we scale fast across Europe. How we onboard, verify and protect those restaurant partners is what keeps that growth safe.

We're looking for a Product Owner for Compliance Technology to join our Payments & Revenue Technology team and own that area end to end: KYC/KYB, restaurant partner (RP) data governance, RP identities and merchant management. Your job is to make compliance something that speeds up our growth, not something that slows it down.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving environment. You'll work closely with the people who feel the impact every day, fix what blocks them now, and make sure the roadmap removes the root cause — with a dedicated engineering squad, working side by side with two fellow Product Owners covering Billing & RevTech and Payments.

**Role Mission

**Make compliance scalable and largely automated as we grow into new markets and volumes, so that we onboard restaurant partners quickly and safely, meet the requirements of our PSP and acquiring partners, and keep one trusted source of truth for who our restaurant partners are.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Get direct, regular feedback from our Sales and Onboarding teams, our restaurant partners, and our PSP partners' compliance operations teams.

• Be the escalation point for compliance issues: dig into cases yourself, unblock restaurant partners quickly, and keep stakeholders informed.

• Turn recurring issues into roadmap items, so we fix problems at the source rather than one case at a time.

• Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for Compliance Technology, and lead your squad through discovery, refinement and delivery.

• Ship in small steps, measure the impact, and adjust quickly as priorities change — tracking what matters, such as onboarding time, automated approval rate and data quality.

• Own the end-to-end onboarding and verification journey for restaurant partners, balancing a smooth experience with the controls our partners and regulators require.

• Own the restaurant partner identity model (legal entities, owners, users and bank accounts) and make sure other teams use this data consistently.

• Own the tools and workflows for managing restaurant partner data after onboarding, especially bank account changes and re-verification.

• Be the product counterpart to our PSP and acquiring partners on compliance: know their rules, anticipate upcoming changes, and build them into the roadmap before they become urgent.

• Combine third-party KYC, AML and fraud vendors with our in-house platform, from evaluation to integration.

• Work closely with Compliance, Legal, Finance, and the Billing & RevTech and Payments Product Owners.

**Must-Have Requirements

**

• Experience owning a product with an engineering team, as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a closely related role.

• Experience with onboarding business customers, ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or payments setting.

• Experience working with PSPs, acquirers, or similar partners and translating their requirements into product decisions.

• A proactive mindset: you think ahead about partner requirements and future regulatory changes, and plan for them rather than react to them.

• Comfortable making good decisions with incomplete information, and preferring to ship something small and improve it rather than wait for the perfect solution.

• Able to prioritise hard when everything feels urgent, and explain why.

• Sees compliance as a way to help the business grow safely, and takes a pragmatic, risk-based approach.

• Gets energy from a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities can change from one month to the next, and wants to grow with the role as the company and team scale.

• Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to align stakeholders without line authority.

**Strong-to-Have Experience

**

• 3+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager.

• Experience with compliance products such as KYC/KYB, AML, or fraud prevention.

• Hands-on experience with KYC, AML screening, or fraud vendors.

• Knowledge of payments and AML regulation, such as PSD2/PSD3 and the EU and UK AML rules.

• Experience with onboarding across several EU markets and the UK.

• Knowledge of restaurant, hospitality, or SME SaaS.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe.

**What We Offer

**

• Ownership of a business-critical product area from day one, with a dedicated squad and room to shape how compliance works at OrderYOYO.

• A hybrid way of working from our Copenhagen or Manchester office, with flexible working hours.

• Close collaboration with, and coaching from, the VP of Payments & Revenue Technology, plus real room to grow as the team scales.

• Work across multiple European markets on products used by 16,000+ restaurant partners.

jobs.description:
**Are you ready to turn strategy into action and help shape the future of Hempel’s Marine business?

**At Hempel, we’re on a mission to double our impact – and to get there, we need bright minds, curious thinkers and strong team players.

In May 2024, the Hempel Foundation – in agreement with the Hempel A/S Board of Directors – invited CVC Funds to become a minority investor in Hempel A/S. This partnership is designed to accelerate Hempel’s ambitious long-term growth strategy, both organically and through acquisitions.

Now, we are looking for a Strategy Projects Manager to join our newly established Marine Strategy & Marketing team.

Reporting to the Director, Strategy & Marketing Marine, you will play an important role in supporting the execution of strategic priorities across our Marine business. You will work across functions and geographies, bringing structure to complex topics, connecting people and perspectives, and ensuring that strategic decisions translate into meaningful business actions.

This is an opportunity to gain broad exposure to our business, work closely with senior stakeholders and make a tangible contribution to the development of Hempel’s Marine strategy.

**Your opportunity to make an impact

**In this role, you will help drive strategic initiatives forward, ensuring clear priorities, effective collaboration and strong execution. You will combine analytical thinking with hands-on project management, working with colleagues across the organization to create alignment and deliver results.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Drive strategic execution – Support the execution of Marine strategic projects, ensuring clear priorities, governance, timelines and aligned processes.

• Strengthen cross-functional collaboration – Establish and improve ways of working and governance that enable better coordination across commercial functions.

• Lead projects from insight to action – Manage selected strategic projects, bringing stakeholders together and ensuring decisions, actions and dependencies are followed through.

• Turn insights into recommendations – Support market, customer and competitor analyses to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions and sharpen our strategic priorities.

• Create structure and momentum – Bring clarity to complex topics, identify what needs to happen next and help ensure progress across multiple initiatives.

• Contribute to the bigger picture – Be part of a collaborative, hands-on team connecting strategy, marketing and execution across Hempel’s Marine business.

**Could this be your next challenge?

**We are looking for someone who combines curiosity and analytical rigour with a practical, business-oriented mindset.

You enjoy solving problems, bringing structure to ambiguity and working with different stakeholders to move initiatives forward. You are comfortable switching between analytical work and hands-on project coordination, and you know how to turn complex information into clear recommendations and actions.

**You Will Ideally Bring

**

• A master's degree in business, economics, engineering, finance or a related field.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to structure problems, assess options and draw sound business conclusions.

• Solid project management skills, with the ability to plan work, coordinate stakeholders and follow through on delivery.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate analysis into concise and compelling presentations.

• A collaborative and proactive approach, with confidence working across functions, cultures and organizational levels.

• Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

**Experience We Imagine You Bring

**Typically, you will have 2–4 years of relevant experience from corporate strategy, business development, commercial, finance, project management or a similar role.

**In Addition, You May Bring

**

• Experience from management consulting, which would be an advantage but is not a requirement.

• Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives, establishing structure and governance, and driving actions through to completion.

• A track record of analysing business challenges, developing recommendations and communicating them clearly to stakeholders.

• Experience supporting or independently managing cross-functional projects and producing analysis that informs business decisions.

**The mindset we're looking for

****You Are

**

• Analytical and curious – You enjoy understanding complex business challenges, asking the right questions and exploring different perspectives.

• Structured and solution-oriented – You bring clarity to ambiguity and know how to turn ideas into actionable plans.

• Proactive and driven – You take ownership, follow through and are motivated by making things happen.

• Collaborative and influential – You build relationships, bring people together and create alignment across different functions.

• Business-minded – You understand the importance of connecting strategic thinking with practical business outcomes.

**Ready to make an impact?

**If you are looking for an opportunity to develop your strategic and project management capabilities, work closely with senior stakeholders and contribute to the future direction of Hempel’s Marine business, we would love to hear from you.

Apply by clicking the Apply for Position button and submitting your application and CV in English via our recruitment system. The application deadline is 22nd November, 2026.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

_At Hempel, you’re welcomed to a global community of +7000 colleagues around the world. A workplace built on shared trust, mutual respect and support for each other.

__We’re on a mission to double our impact. To succeed, we need bright minds and team players. Which is why, from day one, your input, ideas and initiative are not only welcomed, but expected. In return, you will enjoy great opportunities for development in a growing global company – and be part of the solution by contributing to our global impact.

jobs.occupation: Re-advertisement: Multi-physics modelling of wetting–drying induced ground movement, landslides and coastal erosion
jobs.employer_name: Technical Sciences - Institut for byggeri og Bygni
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 01 April 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Re-advertisement: Multi-physics modelling of wetting–drying induced ground movement, landslides and coastal erosion

Research area and project description
We are looking for a motivated and talented PhD candidate to join our multidisciplinary research team investigating climate-driven geohazards affecting infrastructure and the built environment. The successful candidate will become part of the long-term Villum Foundation research programme Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment (CEBE), bringing together researchers in geotechnical, structural, coastal and environmental engineering.

The PhD project focuses on developing a multi-physics platform to simulate the coupled hydromechanical behaviour of soil interacting with water in a geotechnical context. The overall objective is to establish a combination of numerical methods under the umbrella of multi-physics modelling to assess the stability of slopes and embankments subjected to wetting–drying cycles, changes in groundwater level and saturation, surface erosion from stormwater and debris, and toe erosion from waves in coastal environments.

The integrated modelling tool should describe the onset of slope instability, accounting for different hydroclimatic triggering factors (including variations induced by climate change scenarios), and the evolution of mass movement, considering large deformation. Therefore, different numerical methods may be combined, leveraging on the advantages of each approach for simulating a specific phase of the process. It is not the intent to develop new constitutive models for specific soil types, but it may be relevant to explore the use of meso-scale models for soils such as till and fissured clays, both native to Denmark. However, while the main application should be Danish soils, the numerical framework should be developed with versatility in mind to allow the assessment of climate-driven geohazards generally in urban and coastal regions.

Project description 
Applicants should submit a short research proposal (maximum 4 000 keystrokes) that demonstrates their understanding of the scientific challenge, identifies key knowledge gaps, formulates research objectives and hypotheses, outlines a possible methodological approach, and explains why their background makes them well-suited for the project. The proposal will be refined together with the supervisors during the PhD.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a BSc degree (180 ECTS) in civil engineering (or a closely related engineering discipline) and an MSc degree (minimum 90 ECTS) with a specialisation in geotechnical engineering, or computational engineering or coastal engineering, including advanced coursework in numerical methods, finite element analysis, and geotechnical engineering.

Further requirements:
• Excellent communication skills in spoken and written English are required.
• Applicants are expected to have experience in numerical modelling.
• Demonstrated programming skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB, Fortran, C++, or a similar scientific programming language) are required.
Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Navitas, Inge Lehmanns Gade 10, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
 
• Lars Vabbersgaard Andersen, lva@cae.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Felipe Prada, felipe.prada@cae.au,dk (co-supervisor)
• Denis Istrati, distrati@cae.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk
How to apply
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 05 December 2026 at 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 April 2027.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which everyone has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants. All interested candidates are encouraged to apply, regardless of their personal background. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with applicable collective agreement.

Taler og forstår enten dansk, engelsk eller thai.

Has solid practical experience as a chef - preferably with a specialization in or in-depth knowledge of Thai/Asian cuisine.

Works in a structured, hygienic manner and takes pride in the fact that each and every dish leaves the kitchen in high quality.

Is stable in meetings, aware of responsibility and a good team player.

Speaks and understands either Danish, English or Thai.

A permanent full-time position (40 hours per week) in a well-established and healthy company.

An informal and friendly workplace with experienced colleagues, where we help each other.

Salary according to qualifications and applicable conditions.

The Nordic Humanities Center for Challenge-Based Inquiry invites applications for a 2-year postdoc to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

In recent years, a set of overlapping but different concepts have been used to describe a more world-oriented direction of the research conducted at universities: applied science, mission-driven research, challenge-based inquiry etc. These concepts and methods take on specific forms when they are adopted in the humanities. From a sociology of science or history of science perspective, the postdoc is expected 1) to map recent years' transformation within the academy towards challenge-based approaches and specific initiatives in Denmark and the Nordic countries – with a focus on the humanities, 2) to map how Danish and Nordic scholars in the humanities themselves engage in and conceptualize research on societal challenges, how they cooperate with external partners, and what humanists themselves consider to be the possibilities and challenges of this type of research, 3) to conduct an individual research project within this area, and 4) to contribute to the activities and events in the center.

The Nordic Humanities Center for Challenge-Based Inquiry is an innovative and ambitious center of advanced study that fosters new ways of doing humanities research. The center has been established in a collaboration between the faculties of the Humanities at the University of Copenhagen and the University of Southern Denmark with the generous support of the A.P. Møller Foundation. Over the course of the next six years, the center will each year gather a group of scholars at the two universities to marshal insights from the humanities and develop new perspectives, nuances, frames, and narratives for one of the many local and global societal challenges such as, for example, inequality, war, health, artificial intelligence, or the climate crisis. 

A more detailed description of the center and its mission can be found here

jobs.occupation: Eksport Driver
jobs.description:
Kunne du tænke dig et spændende job i transportbranchen som lastbilchauffør, og køre med varer for en stor virksomhed?

Du vil stå for transport og distribution af varer for Salling Group i Danmark.

Du kommer til at arbejde med dygtige kollegaer, der engagerer sig indenfor alle hjørner af godstransport - og ikke mindst brænder for at yde den bedste kundeservice.

Derfor ser vi dig som en serviceminded person, der altid sætter kundens behov og tilfredshed først. Du skal kunne kommunikere med kunderne på dansk eller engelsk.

Du skal være i besiddelse af C og CE-kørekort samt et EU kvalifikationsbevis.

Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt, samt være erfaren og sikker i trafikken.

Derudover skal du være mødestabil, ansvarsfuld og pålidelig.

Straffeattest skal vises.

Would you like an exciting job in the transport industry as a truck driver, driving goods for a large company?

You will be responsible for the transport and distribution of goods for Salling Group in Denmark.

You will work with skilled colleagues who are involved in all aspects of freight transport - and are not least passionate about providing the best customer service.

Therefore, we see you as a service-minded person who always puts the customer's needs and satisfaction first. You must be able to communicate with customers in Danish or English.

You must have a C and CE driving license and an EU qualification certificate.

You must be able to work independently, and be experienced and safe in traffic.

In addition, you must be punctual, responsible and reliable.

A criminal record must be shown.

jobs.occupation: Methods for design of biobased building enclosure systems with a regenerative environmental impact
jobs.employer_name: Technical Sciences - Institut for byggeri og Bygni
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Methods for design of biobased building enclosure systems with a regenerative environmental impact

Research area and project description
The objective of this Ph.D. project is to define methods for design of building enclosure systems following a paradigm for obtaining a regenerative environmental impact. The project aims to define a gated process for design of such systems and demonstrate its operationalisation in the actual development of building systems in collaboration with producers and companies in the building industry.

The methodological approach will be a combination of co-creation techniques where the Ph.D. student actively engages with the building industry to develop practical and useful design methods and workflows that leads to a regenerative environmental performance of building systems. The work is centered around the use of biobased materials in systems with longevity in terms of building physics. Concepts of circularity is expected to be a lever for this.

The background for the project is that the planetary boundaries are overstepped due to excessive environmental load from human activities which means that humanity has entered a zone of risk of deleterious or even catastrophic environmental change at continental to global scales. The main driver for this is the built environment that e.g. accounts for approx. 43% of all energy-related CO2-emissions. There is therefore an acute need to reduce the environmental load from the built environment to a level that enables the regenerative properties of the planetary ecosystems to reestablish the safe operating space below the planetary boundaries.

Qualifications and specific competences
The candidate must have a technical background in building science such as B.Sc. or B.Eng. or similar. Applicants must furthermore have a technical master’s degree or at least one year of master’s degree in building science, environmental performance of buildings or similar topics. Documented skills in application of life-cycle assessments for buildings, hygrothermal performance simulations, and computer programming is mandatory. Experience in heat and moisture measurements in relation to buildings is preferred but not required.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering, Inge Lehmanns gade 10, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Professor Steffen Petersen, e-mail: stp@cae.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Assistant Professor Pil Brix Purup, e-mail: pil@cae.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 2 December 2026 23:59 CET.
Preferred starting date is 1 February 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:

• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

jobs.occupation: Junior Key Account Manager – Renewable Energy Solutions
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about technical sales, building customer relationships and the future of renewable energy?

At Photomate, we are looking for a motivated and proactive Junior Key Account Manager to join our team in Denmark.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a technical mindset and commercial drive who wants to develop their sales career in the fast-growing renewable energy sector.

About Photomate

Photomate is an international renewable energy company specializing in solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), EV charging and smart energy solutions.

We support our business partners with innovative technologies, technical expertise and reliable service. As our business in Denmark continues to grow, we are looking for a new colleague to strengthen our commercial team.

Your Responsibilities

As a Junior Key Account Manager, you will work with both existing customers and new business opportunities in the Danish market.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Building and developing relationships with customers and business partners.

• 
Identifying and approaching potential new B2B customers.

• 
Participating in customer meetings and presenting our technical products and solutions.

• 
Following up on quotations, sales opportunities and customer inquiries.

• 
Working closely with our technical team to understand customer needs and identify suitable solutions.

• 
Maintaining customer information and sales activities in our CRM system.

• 
Supporting Photomate's business growth in Denmark.

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a commercially minded person who is genuinely interested in technology, enjoys understanding how technical solutions work and is motivated by developing customer relationships.

Ideally, you:

• 
Have initial experience in technical B2B sales, account management or a customer-facing role within a technical industry, or have a relevant technical education combined with strong commercial motivation.

• 
Have a genuine interest in technical products and enjoy learning how different solutions work.

• 
Enjoy building relationships and actively approaching new customers.

• 
Are structured, proactive and results-oriented.

• 
Are curious, eager to learn and comfortable discussing technical topics with customers and colleagues.

• 
Are fluent in both Danish and English, written and spoken (mandatory).

• 
Are willing to travel within Denmark for customer meetings.

Experience in solar energy, battery storage, electrical distribution, EV charging, HVAC, industrial equipment or other technically driven B2B sectors is highly valued.

Direct experience in renewable energy is not essential, but a technical mindset and genuine enthusiasm for technology are key requirements. We are looking for someone who wants to understand the products they sell, not just sell them.

What We Offer

• 
An exciting opportunity in a growing international renewable energy company.

• 
Product training and support from experienced sales and technical colleagues.

• 
The opportunity to develop your own customer portfolio and grow into a Key Account Management role.

• 
Professional development and increasing responsibility.

• 
An international and collaborative working environment.

• 
The chance to contribute to the green energy transition.

Interested in Joining Us?

If you are commercially driven, technically curious and want to build your career in renewable energy sales, we would love to hear from you!

Location: Denmark – Copenhagen

Start date: By agreement

Apply: career@photomate.eu

We look forward to hearing from you!
